title: Make sidebar border react to hover events
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

If `showSidebarBorder=False`, the sidebar border shows up on hover, to indicate that you can resize. That’s fine!

But if `showSidebarBorder=True`, we don’t change it when hovering. Should we make it darker or wider or both?

### Why?

Would feel a bit nicer + make it more discoverable that you can drag this to resize the sidebar. 

### How?

Needs a design!

### Additional Context

_No response_
